violation_type.title: Post Notice of Permit Renewal (26 TAC §745.479)
violation_type.typical_finding: The notice of the permit renewal was not posted. This was corrected at the inspection when the director printed and posted it.

finding_variants.text: The notice of the permit renewal was not posted. This was corrected at the inspection when the director printed and posted it.
The permit renewal notice was not posted.    This was corrected at inspection when the permit renewal notice was posted.
The most recent permit renewal notice from October 2024 was not posted.     This was corrected at inspection when the most recent permit renewal was posted.
During the inspection the permit renewal was not posted with the required postings.  This was immediately corrected during the inspection, placing the operation back into compliance.
